Title: Delay learning based on temporal coding in Spiking Neural Networks
Authors: Sun, Pengfei; Wu, Jibin; Zhang, Malu; Devos, Paul; Botteldooren, Dick
Notes: Gradient-based (two variants). DLTC: learns delays together with adjustable thresholds. Image tasks: temporal-coded SNN with non-leaky IF neurons, TTFS coding and firing times obtained in closed form. Audio task: delays only in the input layer, with delay gradients approximated by finite differences, in a SLAYER network trained with a surrogate gradient.

Title: Learning delays through gradients and structure: emergence of spatiotemporal patterns in spiking neural networks
Authors: Mészáros, Balázs; Knight, James C.; Nowotny, Thomas
Notes: Gradient-based (surrogate gradient: BPTT with an arctan surrogate). Compares per-synapse delay learning (DCLS) with dynamic pruning and rewiring (DEEP R + RigL), which also changes the connectivity.

Title: Synaptic delay learning algorithm for feedforward Spiking Neural Networks based on spike train kernel
Source: Proceedings of the Romanian Academy, Series A: Mathematics, Physics, Technical Sciences, Information Science
Authors: Wang, Xiangwen; Li, Xun; Zou, Li; Fan, Jingxing
Notes: Gradient-based (gradient descent on spike-train kernels). Online (FFOnDD) and offline (FFOffDD) rules for weights and delays. The authors state that the derivation does not depend on the neuron model.

Title: Bioplausible Unsupervised Delay Learning for Extracting Spatiotemporal Features in Spiking Neural Networks
Authors: Nadafian, Alireza; Ganjtabesh, Mohammad
Notes: Unsupervised delay learning rule that depends only on the spike times of pre- and postsynaptic neurons, with mathematical proofs that a neuron learns repeating spatiotemporal patterns. Applied in an STDP-based network with a convolutional layer of LIF neurons, first-spike coding and adaptive thresholds.

Title: Delay learning for spiking neurons with multiple synaptic connections
Source: Proceedings of the Romanian Academy, Series A: Mathematics, Physics, Technical Sciences, Information Science
Authors: Zou, Li; Wang, Suichan; Zhang, Hong; Liang, Tongrui; Zhang, Ming; Wang, Xiangwen
Notes: Gradient-based (gradient descent on spike-train kernels). Online and offline rules. Single-layer network of short-term SRM neurons with multiple synaptic connections between each pair of neurons, each with its own weight and delay.

Title: Efficient event-based delay learning in spiking neural networks
Authors: Mészáros, Balázs; Knight, James C.; Nowotny, Thomas
Notes: Gradient-based (exact event-based gradients with respect to weights and delays, EventProp). Supports multiple spikes per neuron and delays on recurrent connections. LIF neurons; feedforward and recurrent networks.

Title: Conduction Delay Learning Model for Unsupervised and Supervised Classification of Spatio-Temporal Spike Patterns
Authors: Matsubara, Takashi
Notes: Stochastic approximation of the Expectation-Maximization algorithm (Bernoulli mixture models). Axonal delays with synaptic weights; both unsupervised and supervised classification.

Title: Conduction delay plasticity can robustly learn spatiotemporal patterns embedded in noise
Source: 2021 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Arnold, Joshua; Stratton, Peter; Wiles, Janet
Notes: Simplified version of the synaptic delay variance learning (SDVL) conduction-delay plasticity rule; unsupervised learning of repeating spatiotemporal patterns embedded in noise.

Title: A new recursive least squares-based learning algorithm for spiking neurons
Authors: Zhang, Yun; Qu, Hong; Luo, Xiaoling; Chen, Yi; Wang, Yuchen; Zhang, Malu; Li, Zefang
Notes: Recursive least-squares weight learning combined with a modified synaptic delay learning rule.

Title: A Delay Learning Algorithm Based on Spike Train Kernels for Spiking Neurons
Authors: Wang, Xiangwen; Lin, Xianghong; Dang, Xiaochao
Notes: Gradient-based (gradient descent on spike-train kernels). Short-term memory SRM neurons. Spike-train learning tasks and image classification with latency-phase encoding.

Title: DL-ReSuMe: A Delay Learning-Based Remote Supervised Method for Spiking Neurons
Source: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
Authors: Taherkhani, Aboozar; Belatreche, Ammar; Li, Yuhua; Maguire, Liam P.
Notes: ReSuMe (STDP and anti-STDP) for weights combined with delay shifting. Trained to reproduce desired spike trains on synthetic data (Problem Type: Regression).

Title: Adaptive Delay Learning in SpikeProp Based on Delay Convergence Analysis
Source: 2016 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Shrestha, Sumit Bam; Song, Qing
Notes: Gradient-based (SpikeProp: error gradient computed through the output spike times). Delay learning with an adaptive learning rate for the delays, derived from a delay convergence analysis. SRM0 neurons; population encoding with Gaussian receptive fields.

Title: A Supervised Learning Algorithm for Learning Precise Timing of Multiple Spikes in Multilayer Spiking Neural Networks
Source: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
Authors: Taherkhani, Aboozar; Belatreche, Ammar; Li, Yuhua; Maguire, Liam P.
Notes: Multilayer network: hidden-neuron weights trained with STDP and anti-STDP; output-neuron weights and delays trained with Extended Delay Learning (EDL).

Title: A spiking-timing-based model for classification
Source: 2016 13th International Computer Conference on Wavelet Active Media Technology and Information Processing (ICCWAMTIP)
Authors: Yang, Bo; Wang, Yangyang; Li, Jianping
Notes: DL-ReSuMe with phase encoding for optical character recognition.

Title: Multi-DL-ReSuMe: Multiple neurons Delay Learning Remote Supervised Method
Source: 2015 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Taherkhani, Aboozar; Belatreche, Ammar; Li, Yuhua; Maguire, Liam P.
Notes: Extension of DL-ReSuMe that trains multiple neurons instead of a single neuron to classify spatiotemporal spike patterns.

Title: Three factor delay learning rules for spiking neural networks
Authors: Vassallo, Luke; Taherinejad, Nima
Notes: Gradient-based (surrogate gradient: a Gaussian surrogate used only to compute the eligibility traces). Online three-factor rules based on eligibility propagation. LIF hidden neurons and a leaky-integrator readout; feedforward and recurrent networks. The coding scheme is not specified.

Title: Predicting Temporal Sequences Using an Event-based Spiking Neural Network Incorporating Learnable Delays
Source: 2014 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Gibson, Tingting Amy; Henderson, James A.; Wiles, Janet
Notes: New spiking neuron model with learnable dendritic and axonal delays, represented by Gaussian distributions whose parameters are learned online in a self-supervised way (Trained Parameters: Other); the Kullback-Leibler divergence selects the best-matching distribution. Forecasts DVS128 event sequences (Problem Type: Regression).

Title: Rethinking skip connections in Spiking Neural Networks with Time-To-First-Spike coding
Authors: Kim, Youngeun; Kahana, Adar; Yin, Ruokai; Li, Yuhang; Stinis, Panos; Karniadakis, George Em; Panda, Priyadarshini
Notes: Gradient-based (cross-entropy loss on the output spike times, which follow from the non-leaky IF neuron model of Mostafa, 2017; Adam optimizer). Learnable delays only on concatenation-based skip connections, to align the convolutional and skip paths. TTFS coding.

Title: Delay-DSGN: A Dynamic Spiking Graph Neural Network with Delay Mechanisms for Evolving Graph
Authors: Wang, Zhiqiang; Wen, Jianghao; Liang, Jianqing
Notes: Gradient-based (backpropagation; the authors derive conditions on the standard deviation and size of the Gaussian delay kernel that keep gradients from exploding or vanishing). Gaussian delay kernel in the neighbourhood aggregation of a dynamic spiking graph neural network; node classification.

Title: Adaptive Axonal Delays in Feedforward Spiking Neural Networks for Accurate Spoken Word Recognition
Source: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
Authors: Sun, Pengfei; Eqlimi, Ehsan; Chua, Yansong; Devos, Paul; Botteldooren, Dick
Notes: Gradient-based (SLAYER-PyTorch framework). Learnable axonal delays capped at a maximum value that adapts to the delay distribution of each layer.

Title: Axonal Delay as a Short-Term Memory for Feed Forward Deep Spiking Neural Networks
Source: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
Authors: Sun, Pengfei; Zhu, Longwei; Botteldooren, Dick
Notes: Gradient-based (SLAYER-PyTorch framework; axonal delays and weights updated by gradient descent). Rectified axonal delay (RAD) module; fully connected and convolutional networks.

Title: Training multi-layer spiking neural networks with plastic synaptic weights and delays
Authors: Wang, Jing
Notes: Gradient-based (SpikeProp: chain rule through the output spike times). Extension of SpikeProp that learns synaptic weights and delays in multilayer networks of SRM neurons.

Title: BKT-DSNN: Communication efficient spiking neural network federated learning based on dynamic model assignment
Authors: Qu, Ziao; Sun, Hao
Notes: Gradient-based (backpropagation; a Gaussian-kernel delayed convolution, DCLS, relaxes the discrete delay positions). Federated-learning framework; weights and synaptic delays are learned with a discrete-time algorithm based on membrane-potential configurations.

Title: A synaptic weight-delay synergistic learning algorithm for deep spiking neural networks
Authors: Wang, Xiangwen; Li, Xun; Xu, Yikai; Zou, Li; Su, Shunchang; Lin, Xianghong
Notes: Gradient-based (gradients computed on spike-train kernel representations). SWDSL: joint learning of weights and delays; offline and online modes.

Title: Beyond rate coding: surrogate gradients enable spike timing learning in spiking neural networks
Authors: Yu, Ziqiao; Sun, Pengfei; Goodman, Dan F. M.
Notes: Gradient-based (surrogate gradient, SLAYER framework). Learns synaptic weights, axonal delays and a membrane time constant shared by all neurons (Trained Parameters: Other).

Title: Supervised Learning in Multilayer Spiking Neural Networks With Spike Temporal Error Backpropagation
Source: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
Authors: Luo, Xiaoling; Qu, Hong; Wang, Yuchen; Yi, Zhang; Zhang, Jilun; Zhang, Malu
Notes: Gradient-based (exact derivatives of postsynaptic spike times with respect to presynaptic spike times). Spike temporal error backpropagation.

Title: Learnable axonal delay in spiking neural networks improves spoken word recognition
Authors: Sun, Pengfei; Chua, Yansong; Devos, Paul; Botteldooren, Dick
Notes: Gradient-based (surrogate gradient: BPTT with an exponential surrogate). Learnable axonal delays, clipped to a range and rounded after each update, combined with local skip connections and an auxiliary loss.

Title: Co-learning synaptic delays, weights and adaptation in spiking neural networks
Authors: Deckers, Lucas; Van Damme, Laurens; Van Leekwijck, Werner; Tsang, Ing Jyh; Latré, Steven
Notes: Gradient-based (surrogate gradient: BPTT with a boxcar surrogate). Constrained adaptive LIF neurons (cAdLIF); learns weights, delays and neuronal adaptation parameters (Trained Parameters: Other).

Title: Learning to synchronize: A delay-based plasticity rule for temporal coding in spiking networks
Authors: Garamov, Konstantin A.; Lobov, Sergey A.
Notes: Synchronizing Learning Rule (SLR): unsupervised rule that changes conduction delays from local spike-timing traces; weights are not modified.

Title: Improving Multispike Learning With Plastic Synaptic Delays
Source: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
Authors: Yu, Qiang; Gao, Jialu; Wei, Jianguo; Li, Jing; Tan, Kay Chen; Huang, Tiejun
Notes: Gradient-based (derivatives of the critical thresholds of the spike-threshold surface with respect to weights and delays). Joint weight-delay plasticity rule (TDP-DL) for multispike learning, built on threshold-driven plasticity (TDP).

Title: Unsupervised learning of visual representations using delay-weight spike-timing-dependent plasticity
Source: 2022 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Fois, Adrien; Rostro-Gonzalez, Horacio; Girau, Bernard
Notes: Separate STDP rules for delays and for weights; unsupervised learning of visual representations by vector quantization (Problem Type: Clustering).

Title: Supervised learning in Spiking Neural Networks with Limited Precision: SNN/LP
Source: 2015 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Stromatias, Evangelos; Marsland, John S.
Notes: Genetic algorithm with 3-bit weights and 3-bit delays.

Title: BPSpike: a backpropagation learning for all parameters in spiking neural networks with multiple layers and multiple spikes
Source: 2016 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
Authors: Matsuda, Satoshi
Notes: Gradient-based (backpropagation, extension of SpikeProp). Learns weights, delays, synaptic time constants and thresholds (Trained Parameters: Other) in multilayer networks with multiple synapses between neurons. No experimental results are reported (Problem Type: Unidentified).

Title: Evolving Axonal Delay Neural Networks for Robot Control
Authors: Jeanson, Francis; White, Anthony
Notes: Evolution of axonal delays with a floating-point genotype; the fitness is based on the average distance of the robot to a light source. All connection weights are fixed to one.

Title: SpiFoG: an efficient supervised learning algorithm for the network of spiking neurons
Authors: Hussain, Irshed; Thounaojam, Dalton Meitei
Notes: Elitist floating-point genetic algorithm with hybrid crossover; trains weights and synaptic delays.

Title: Supervised learning in spiking neural networks with synaptic delay-weight plasticity
Authors: Zhang, Malu; Wu, Jibin; Belatreche, Ammar; Pan, Zihan; Xie, Xiurui; Chua, Yansong; Li, Guoqi; Qu, Hong; Li, Haizhou
Notes: Extension of DL-ReSuMe in which delays can be both increased and decreased; applied to ReSuMe and PBSNLR.

Title: SLAYER: Spike Layer Error Reassignment in Time
Source: 2018 Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
Authors: Shrestha, Sumit Bam; Orchard, Garrick
Notes: Gradient-based (SLAYER: the derivative of the spike function is estimated with the probability density function of spike-state change; temporal credit assignment). Learns weights and axonal delays. Learns precise target spike trains; in classification, the decision is based on output spike counts (Codification: Rate coding + Temporal coding).

Title: Spiking Neural Network with plasticity in the time domain recovers temporal information from a noisy pattern using reference spikes
Authors: Wang, Zeyuan; Cruz, Luis
Notes: Unsupervised STDP for the weights and a spike-timing-dependent delay plasticity rule (STDDP-exp). Recovers a repeating spike pattern hidden in a noisy background (Problem Type: Regression).

Title: Dynamic Spatiotemporal Pattern Recognition With Recurrent Spiking Neural Network
Authors: Shen, Jiangrong; Liu, Jian K.; Wang, Yueming
Notes: Gradient-based (training rule based on Mostafa, 2018: an analytical relation between input and output spike times). Backpropagation based on spike latency and temporal differences in a recurrent network; decoding by the first output spike.

Title: Surpress Redundant Spikes in SpikeProp-Locally Application of Removing Redundant Delays
Source: 2015 7th International Conference on Emerging Trends in Engineering & Technology (ICETET)
Authors: Nakayama, Takutoshi; Matsumoto, Takashi; Takase, Haruhiko; Kawanaka, Hiroharu; Tsuruoka, Shinji
Notes: Gradient-based (SpikeProp: error backpropagation on the output spike times), with adaptive weight decay (AWD) and removal of redundant delays (RD): connections whose delays are judged redundant are removed, which changes the connectivity (Trained Parameters: Weights + Delays + Topology).

Title: TSkips: Efficiency Through Explicit Temporal Delay Connections in Spiking Neural Networks
Authors: Malettira, Prajna G.; Negi, Shubham; Ponghiran, Wachirawit; Roy, Kaushik
Notes: Training-free neural architecture search over skip positions and delay values. Optical flow (regression) and gesture and speech classification.

Title: Adaptive Robot Path Planning Using a Spiking Neuron Algorithm With Axonal Delays
Source: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems
Authors: Hwu, Tiffany; Wang, Alexander Y.; Oros, Nicolas; Krichmar, Jeffrey L.
Notes: Learning rule that changes axonal delays according to traversal costs; path planning on an autonomous robot.
